PROCEDURE print_check_val IS

 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 P_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
-- WIN_API_DIALOG.SELECT_PRINTER(P_NAME , P_PORT , TRUE );
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,'P_NAME'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_USR_TYPE_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:USR_TYPE_CD);
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5); 
BEGIN 
 SELECT count(*)
 into v_count
 FROM
 SC_USER_TYPES L_SUT,
 SC_USER_CLASS SC_USR_CLS,
 SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS L_SYSOBJ,
 ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS AS_1,
 ACTIVITY_CLASS_SUBJS ADS
 WHERE
 ADS.SYSOBJ_ID = AS_1.SYSOBJ_ID AND
 ADS.SUBJ_CODE = AS_1.SUBJ_CODE AND
 AS_1.SYSOBJ_ID = L_SYSOBJ.SYSOBJ_ID AND
 ADS.CLASS_CD = SC_USR_CLS.CLASS_CD AND
 ADS.USER_TYPE_CD = SC_USR_CLS.USR_TYPE_CD AND
 SC_USR_CLS.USR_TYPE_CD = L_SUT.USR_TYPE_CD AND
 ((:CLASS_CD IS NULL AND :USR_TYPE_CD IS NULL) OR
 ( ADS.CLASS_CD=:CLASS_CD AND ADS.USER_TYPE_CD=:USR_TYPE_CD));
if v_count > 0 then
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_USR_TYPE_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:USR_TYPE_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:CLASS_CD);
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_LIST_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_list_val IS
 
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_USER_TYPE';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة الاختيار ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_USER_TYPE.fmx',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,QUERY_ONLY,pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.USR_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 :USR_TYPE_CD:= :GLOBAL.USR_TYPE_CD ;
 :USR_TYPE_NAME:= :GLOBAL.USR_TYPE_NAME;



 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;
